verdict.rationale: LocalAI ships as a Docker image and single binary with a CLI (`local-ai run`, `docker run -p 8080:8080`) and an OpenAI-compatible API, making it straightforward to start headlessly and script against; PRELOAD_MODELS and --external-grpc-backends support automated, non-interactive startup, and the CPU path is explicitly noted as CI-tested. However there is no explicit documentation of running LocalAI itself inside a CI pipeline, GitHub Actions example, or headless test-automation guide. Missing for 10: explicit CI/pipeline integration docs, example GitHub Actions workflow, and confirmation of non-interactive exit codes/health checks for automation.
